Summary: Verifies whether onboarding staffing and specialist dependencies support a credible kickoff date.
EntryCriteria: The onboarding brief exists and staffing review is starting.
ExitCriteria: A credible staffing decision exists with named gaps and fallback actions.
Checks: Allocation coverage is explicit for the next onboarding phase.
Known environment or access dependencies are named.
Any capacity gaps have an owner and escalation path.
